gloss: sense of the season; seasonal feeling

definitions.gloss: sense of the season; seasonal feeling; awareness of the season
definitions.explanation: The feeling or awareness evoked by seasonal characteristics — sights, foods, weather, and customs that mark a particular time of year.

examples.japanese: {季節感|きせつかん}のある{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To make food that reflects the season.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}では{季節感|きせつかん}を{感|かん}じにくい。
examples.english: In the city, it's hard to feel a sense of the seasons.

examples.japanese: {旬|しゅん}の{食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}うことで、{食卓|しょくたく}に{季節感|きせつかん}を{取|と}り{入|い}れている。
examples.english: By using seasonal ingredients, I bring a sense of the season to the dinner table.

notes:
Composed of {季節|きせつ} (season) + {感|かん} (sense/feeling). Reflects the deeply valued Japanese cultural concept of appreciating seasonal changes in food, clothing, decoration, and daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節感|きせつかん}がある: to have a seasonal feel
- {季節感|きせつかん}を{感|かん}じる: to feel the season
- {季節感|きせつかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value seasonality
- {季節感|きせつかん}を{取|と}り{入|い}れる: to incorporate seasonal elements
- {季節感|きせつかん}のない: lacking seasonal character

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese culture places great importance on seasonal awareness. This concept appears in cooking ({旬|しゅん}の{食材|しょくざい}, seasonal ingredients), fashion (wearing appropriate colors and fabrics), interior decoration ({季節|きせつ}の{花|はな}), greetings ({時候|じこう}の{挨拶|あいさつ}), and traditional arts like haiku ({季語|きご}, seasonal words).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {風情|ふぜい}: elegance, atmosphere — broader aesthetic appreciation, not limited to seasons
- {情緒|じょうちょ}: sentiment, mood — emotional quality of an experience or place
